page_title: ALA 1-1 OSA | Alaves v Osasuna 24/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Referee Guillermo Cuadra waves Adrian Pica (Alaves) back on as his red card is expunged after a VAR review!
90+7' Adrian Pica (Alaves) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
90+5' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+4' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) hits a dangerous effort towards the roof of the net from the promising free kick. His shot is stopped by a well prepared Antonio Sivera.
90+4' Carles Alena (Alaves) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Osasuna.
90+3' Substitution. Unai Garcia (Osasuna) replaces Ruben Garcia.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 1 - 1 Goal! Alejandro Catena gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Raul Garcia (Osasuna), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 1:1.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
85' A corner kick by Osasuna is thwarted by the well prepared Antonio Sivera (Alaves).
85' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
84' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
83' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Substitution. Bryan Zaragoza leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna).
81' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) was too forceful with his tackle and Guillermo Cuadra interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
79' Eduardo Coudet decides to make a substitution. Carlos Protesoni will be replaced by Carlos Martin (Alaves).
79' Substitution. Adrian Pica (Alaves) has come on for Aleksandar Sedlar.
78' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Jesus Areso (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
77' Facundo Garces (Alaves) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
76' Toni Martinez (Alaves) is penalised for a foul. Guillermo Cuadra had a clear view and blows his whistle.
75' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
74' Toni Martinez (Alaves) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
71' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
68' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
65' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
64' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) sends a long ball in, but Antonio Sivera comfortably gathers the ball.
63' Substitution. Jon Guridi walks off the pitch and Tomas Conechny (Alaves) comes on as a substitute.
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Toni Martinez (Alaves) is replacing Kike Garcia.
61' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar.
59' Vicente Moreno has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abel Bretones (Osasuna) replacing Juan Cruz.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is coming onto the pitch as Pablo Ibanez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
58' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' 1 - 0 Goal! Carlos Vicente (Alaves) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Sergio Herrera to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
56' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
55' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Alaves!

53' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Antonio Sivera shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
52' The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.
51' The Alaves players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
48' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
46' Substitution. Lucas Torro will be replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Now Osasuna have a corner.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Kike Garcia (Alaves) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
44' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
44' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
42' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
42' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
36' The cross fools the defence and leaves Ante Budimir (Osasuna) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post.
35' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance!
34' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Guillermo Cuadra signals. Osasuna have a free kick from a promising distance.
34' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is penalised for holding. Guillermo Cuadra signals a set piece.
32' A bullet header by Kike Garcia (Alaves) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the left post.
32' A cross from a corner kick by Alaves is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
31' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Sergio Herrera has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
30' Osasuna take a short corner kick.
29' Wow, what an escape. Lucas Torro (Osasuna) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
26' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
24' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul after Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) hacks down one of his opponents.
19' Kike Garcia (Alaves) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
16' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

16' Carles Alena (Alaves) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The referee blows his whistle, Alaves are awarded a corner kick.

15' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Antonio Sivera shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
14' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
12' Jon Guridi (Alaves) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar.
9' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

9' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is out of play. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner.

5' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
5' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Alaves.
5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
4' Alaves keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Alaves will kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra will supervise the game today.
